brief:
Conditions for detainees held in Gaza prisons have deteriorated significantly, the Ma'an news agency reported. The situation underscores mounting concerns about the treatment and welfare of those in custody as attempts to intervene on their behalf have stalled.

Advocates for prisoner welfare have expressed alarm over the trajectory of conditions inside the facilities. The absence of coordinated action to address the crisis has left detainees facing compounding hardships with limited prospect of intervention in the near term.
title: Gaza prisoners' conditions worsen amid lack of rescue efforts
